conclusions.text_zh: FULL10k在完整TRAIN4096下降不能据此推断泛化退化或停止控制臂；其完整NAVTEST同期提升。
当前仅发布IL70与FULL两份完整4096总体；ADAPT尚未完成，没有填造第三模型或partial-scene均值。

estimator_notes.physical_log_equal: Mean of per-log subgroup means; broad panels span162 TRAIN physical logs.
estimator_notes.population_log_reweighted_TRAIN_projecti: Per-log mean weighted by full NAVTRAIN N_log (equivalent scene weights N_log/n_log). Descriptive TRAIN projection, not a canonical full103288 evaluation or NAVTEST. For exposure-conditioned subsets this is a represented-log projection, not an unbiased population estimator.
estimator_notes.scene_mean: Raw mean over selected scenes; fixed panel is almost equally allocated over physical logs, not103288 scenes.

limits: TRAIN includes old DEV; none of these groups is an independent heldout Test.
Extra3072 are feedback-unseen, while only the exposure0 subset is training-unseen under the recorded ADAPT census.
Exposure-conditioned contrasts are confounded by deliberate sampling of difficult/regressing scenes; bootstrap is descriptive and exploratory.
No new inference seed, policy or adaptive selection recipe is introduced.

next_stage_recommendations.action: Keep FULL matched control; finish ADAPT10k4096 diagnosis without changing current adaptive feedback.
